head: 42ae95d146ceb441ff91ea33dbbed581c33de305
method: All sixty current source files were read for content. Current policy, owner authorization, all three canonical validator modules, current UTC implementation and regression diff, old source findings/log, and current red/green/full-failure originals were also read. Filesystem selection and byte hashes were inspected read-only. The reviewer did not implement or run tests.

dimensions.rationale: The 38-line AGENTS index routes detailed operating rules; the current 8.0.37 README separates source readiness, component release, runtime conformance and product qualification. Token/context policy keeps stable instructions, dynamic work and raw evidence distinct. No source document grants current live qualification.

Selected requirements, tasks and negative results trace actual acceptance and external blockers. The single canonical workflow validates scoped review evidence before positive review or archive transitions, checks open finding counts, preserves declared AI identity and archive provenance, and rejects stale source/policy evidence. New UTC requirements and design preserve the existing authority.

Read-only inspection found no material applicable MCP configuration. The source evaluator's not-applicable path is justified and still requires delegated review. MCP governance preserves approval, credentials, pinned dependencies and runtime-disabled boundaries; local synthetic Go SDK tests do not certify a real provider or live tool.

The six selected state files retain historical local/external statuses; runbooks preserve lifecycle ownership, raw-source retention, deliberate knowledge compilation, memory conflict/freshness decisions, delivery and runtime-method boundaries. Historical state existence is not counted as a newly completed field campaign.

Actual test and CI entry points preserve negative cases and failure propagation. The review contract requires independent declared identity, both verdicts, exact byte binding and no open major/blocker. Catalog/eval tests explicitly deny runtime execution or release authority. The current 45-test green and retained 99/101 failure are distinguished; full-suite success is not claimed.

The public backup restore reaches the typed transaction implementation: bounded gzip checksum and whole tar inventory validation precede moving the selected target; links, traversal, wrong roots, duplicates and special entries are rejected. Private same-parent staging, atomic replacement, compensation and unresolved-staging refusal preserve recovery copies. Eight source tests cover ordinary and failure paths, including second compensation failure. The previously fixed HARNESS-RECOVERY-001 remains historical, not erased.

Ownership, bounded scanning, format/catalog checks and explicit official-source freshness governance remain. The Harness entry now samples the current UTC day once and passes it to all seven dimensions; gate still rejects explicit as_of, future tolerance remains zero and max age remains 90 days. The three shared validator files retain their previous hashes. Current source review is required because README/readiness bytes changed; changing an old date would not satisfy the binding.

utc_increment.production_changes: Only readiness.py imports datetime/timezone and uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() for the existing default effective_as_of.
utc_increment.test_boundary: New deterministic cases model local day both before and after UTC, plus the real delegated Harness path. Two shell test dates now use UTC. No system clock, TZ, HOME, policy, validator or historical receipt was changed by this reviewer.

retained_failed_full.interpretation: One correct stale-source-review rejection after README changed, and one real local-date versus UTC defect. These actual failed results are preserved; this source verdict does not replace the pending fresh gate/full regression.

limitations: This is a real independent AI source review under the existing owner delegation, not a human signature or identity authentication by a file hash.
Source-readiness conclusions are six applicable pass dimensions and one justified tool N/A; current field status remains not-verified.
The canonical current receipt has not yet been created or validated. Aggregate dual verdict awaits the independent Quality report and a later actual completion time.
No tests were executed by this reviewer. Current command results are attributed to their actual executor and supported by preserved original stdout/stderr and receipts.
Fresh full regression, protected CI, immutable release and downstream exact promotion remain separate unapproved delivery gates.
A new reproducible pipe mechanism does not reconstruct the exact inner command or root cause of the October 20 historical Broken pipe event.
The source list is a frozen selected evidence set, not an assertion that every repository file or every live integration has been semantically verified.
